name: Weather Agent Tests
description: Sample test cases for evaluating a weather agent's tool usage and response quality.

eval_cases.name: basic_city_query
eval_cases.expected_response: The current weather in Tokyo is 22°C, partly cloudy with light winds.

rubrics.name: accuracy
rubrics.description: Does the response include accurate weather data?

levels.description: Complete accurate weather details with temperature and conditions

eval_cases.name: multi_city_comparison
eval_cases.input: Compare the weather in London, Paris, and Berlin for this weekend.
eval_cases.expected_response: This weekend: London will be rainy at 14°C, Paris partly sunny at 20°C, and Berlin warm and clear at 24°C. Pack layers for London!

eval_cases.name: unknown_location
eval_cases.expected_response: I couldn't find weather data for Atlantis. Could you verify the city name? Atlantis is a mythical underwater city, so no weather data exists for it.

rubrics.name: helpfulness
rubrics.description: How well does the agent handle unknown locations?

levels.description: Explains the issue and suggests nearby valid locations

eval_cases.name: weather_alert_request
eval_cases.input: Are there any weather warnings in Florida right now?
eval_cases.expected_response: Yes, there's an active tropical storm warning for South Florida. Expected rainfall of 3-5 inches over the next 48 hours.
